text:
ana: heads-up — onboarding q8b-int4 on staging showed small longform recall drop vs q8b-fp16. want to assemble a focused mini-golden and light relabel before promoting.
lee: can you share quick numbers?
nana: ran 320 long-context turns. summary:
```
metric    fp16   int4   delta
recall@20 0.835  0.802  -0.033
rougeL    0.44   0.428  -0.012
lat(ms)   240    170   -70
```
sam: looks like kvcache rollover + quant rounding maybe. propose: 1) create 160-item mini-golden (120 long recall-sensitive + 40 entity probes) 2) run paraphrase + fingerprint dedupe 3) 3-way relabel consensus.
labeler-bot: created ML-GOLD-175001 for "q8b-int4 mini-golden relabel". 160 items assigned. ETA 36h.
infra: staging has headroom for parallel evals; if you need more quota ping me.
lee: dedupe plan: fuzzyhash + embed-sim 0.87 threshold, manual triage on collisions. label instructions: prioritize recall, tag ENTITY_LOSS.
nana: good. will kick dedupe and post s3 link. target: <2% drop post-relabel.
labeler-bot: dedupe complete; collisions ~15%. launching relabel.
labeler-bot: relabel done: 160 -> consensus 150 (10 abstains). s3://redwood-qa/q8b-int4-mini/175001/results.json
ana: eval after relabel: recall@20 = 0.820 (delta -0.015). within threshold. recommend limited dedicated canary with monitoring (recall, ENTITY_LOSS rate).
sam: +1. set gate: hold if ENTITY_LOSS > 1.2% or recall drop > 1.5%.
nana: filing rollout ticket and tagging golden as `q8b-int4-mini-20250112`. thanks team :rocket:
